narrative.details:
Haha! Done! The shackles are done!

It's time, Lucien. It's time, Servo!

Are you ready to bear witness to the perfect blend of alchemy, engineering, and the arcane, adventurer?

I shall summon forth a powerful elemental now. This is a groundbreaking day for all of us.
narrative.objectives: Defeat the Fam'retor Guardian and bring Lotwil's Shackles of Elemental Binding back to Lotwil Veriatus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, adventurer. That was quite an ordeal, wasn't it?

I'm not sure what could have gone wrong. It was a good thing my magics were here to help send the creature back to its home plane.

Perhaps a little token of appreciation for all your hard work...
narrative.requestItemsText: Not quite the outcome I was expecting. Could you get my shackles back?
